in_arabic.name: عكرم
in_arabic.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'akrama,' meaning 'to honor, to respect, to appreciate.' This name signifies a person who is noble, generous, and honorable, and who is worthy of respect and admiration.

in_urdu.name: عكرم
in_urdu.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'akrama,' meaning 'to honor, to respect, to appreciate.' In Urdu, this name can be translated to mean 'generous, kind, and radiant.' This name signifies a person who is known for their kindness, generosity, and radiant personality.
